article.title: -(으)ㄴ/는 바람에 causa adversa
article.part: Relaciones lógicas y modalidad básica — 논리 관계와 기본 양태

claims.summary: The NIKL guide describes **-는 바람에** as a causal expression that typically contributes to a negative result. It also specifies that the form does not combine with past -었- in the cause clause, requires 에, disallows commands/proposals in the following clause, and allows past reference through the documented form. This entry is limited to those constraints.
